prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Helpful changes (won): Reordering sign-in after adoption, specific desktop flows (summon, visibility & control), targeted hints (photo upload, path decision, sign-in security), single-click and card carousel layouts, and desktop control redesigns consistently won.
Harmful changes (worse): Streamlined path copy, companion name certification copy, the account persistence hint, and the spotlight path selector layout significantly hurt performance.
No clear effect: Background notifications, tutorial/showcase screens, wait time/loading indicators, incentives, and various copy and layout variations showed no clear effect.
Predictions too high: Large predicted gains (e.g., +14.0% and +15.0%) were routinely overestimated, often leading to smaller actual gains or no clear effect.
Predictions too low: Major wins were significantly underestimated, most notably the desktop visibility onboarding flow (+4.5% predicted vs +16.6% measured), desktop summon flow (+1.0% vs +8.6%), and sign-in security hint (-4.0% vs +3.1%).

Changes:
0: [choose_path, layout] Two Column Path Decision Layout: Reconfigures the choose path screen into a side-by-side two-column layout comparing preset pets versus custom pet creation. (why: Path selection has a high mean duration of 514s; presenting both options side by side makes the distinction clearer immediately.)
1: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Docking Setup Flow: Adds an interactive screen anchoring step before home intro to define where the pet docks on screen. (why: 3 support tickets reported that pets do not show on the desktop or the app fails to open after onboarding.)
2: [adoption, hint] Custom Photo Multi-Angle Hint: Adds quality guidance copy on photo upload requesting clear front-facing photos with balanced lighting. (why: 3 support tickets mentioned custom pets failing or looking distorted after photo creation.)
3: [finish, incentive] Onboarding Desktop Interaction Callout: Adds a mascot guide component on the final home screen highlighting right-click desktop controls. (why: 3 support emails indicated post-onboarding confusion on how to control, hide, or interact with the pet.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Split Personality Pick Friend Layout: Replaces the pick friend list with a split layout comparing pet personality archetypes side-by-side. (why: Adoption has the lowest conversion rate (64.2%); side-by-side comparison reduces selection indecision.)

scores.note: Path selection has long mean duration but layout variations show minor impact historically (+0.2%).
Desktop setup/visibility flows strongly perform (+16.6% historically) and address specific support complaints.
Targets highest drop-off step (adoption at 64.2%) with photo hints proven to be effective and easy to configure.
Incentives/showcases have weak historical performance despite support emails.
High potential impact at lowest funnel step (adoption); layout redesigns showed +2.7% gain previously.
